products.name: CBB SPC
products.description: A salary packaging card (living expenses card) allows an individual to use pre-tax income for purchases associated with everyday living such as groceries, clothes, fuel or pay for expenses like utility bills.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Need to be employed by an eligible employer.

Availability: The card is only available to employees who work for an eligible employer under Sections 57A and 65J of the Fringe Benefits Tax Assessment Act 1986. These sections grant eligibility to the following employer organisations - Public Benevolent Institutions (charities, etc), Hospitals, Nursing Homes, Government Departments, etc, Rebatable Non-for-Profit Organisations.
Account credits and debits: Only the salary packaging provider/employer can credit the account with pre-tax funds. Cash withdrawals, transfers, direct debits and Bpay payments are not permitted.

products.name: Bank Guarantee Facility Acct
products.description: The Bank Guarantee Facility Account is an account specifically for the purpose of holding funds for cash security requirements on a Beyond Bank Australia approved Bank Guarantee

depositRates.additionalInfo: Interest is calculated daily and paid on the last day of each month into your linked Business Transaction Account which must be held under the same membership.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Available for Business purposes only. Conditions apply.

This account can only be obtained by customers who apply for and are approved for a Beyond Bank Australia cash back, Bank Guarantee. A customer is required to hold a Beyond Bank Business Transaction Account or Community Account under the same membership where interest will be paid into by us.
You must be or become a Beyond Bank Australia member.
Must be an Australian Citizen, permanent Australian resident or hold a visa. The term of the visa must exceed the term of the guarantee.

constraints.additionalInfo: Any balance in this account that exceeds the approved Bank Guarantee amount will be transferred to the customers linked Business Transaction Account or Community Account. The amount held in this account must be the equivalent value of the issued Bank Guarantee.
The amount held in this Bank Guarantee Facility Account must be the equivalent value of the issued Bank Guarantee.

features.additionalInfo: Check account balances 24/7 through Internet or Mobile Banking Services.  View Only access is permitted only on this Bank Guarantee Facility Account.

Funds are held in this account and cannot be accessed by the customer whilst the Bank Guarantee remains valid. Upon expiry or cancellation of the Bank Guarantee your funds will be released to your linked Business Transaction Account or Community Account usually within 7 business days.
Fees are applicable under the terms of the Bank Guarantee. These fees will be disclosed to you as part of your application and terms agreement of the Bank Guarantee.
